name: Glass Relief
description: The shapes of the second clip rise through the first as clear molded glass, bending it and catching the light along their outlines; then the glass fills with the second clip's colors, brightest parts first, and melts flat into it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: refraction
params.description: How strongly the glass bends the picture behind it

params.name: shine
params.description: Brightness of the light caught by the glass

params.name: light
params.description: Direction the light comes from at the peak of the relief; it swings around it during the transition (x right, y up)
